faq.question: Is tent stakes allowed in carry-on bags?
faq.answer: Tent Stakes is not_allowed in carry-on luggage. Tent stakes or pegs are sharp objects and must be packed in checked baggage.

faq.question: Can you pack tent stakes in checked baggage?
faq.answer: Yes, Tent Stakes is allowed in checked bags. Tent stakes are allowed in checked baggage.

faq.question: Can tent stakes go in carry-on luggage?
faq.answer: No. TSA and international aviation rules prohibit metal or sharp tent stakes and tent pegs in carry-on bags because they can be used as weapons. They MUST be packed in checked luggage.

faq.question: Are tent stakes allowed in checked baggage?
faq.answer: Yes! Tent stakes, tent poles, and camping pegs are 100% allowed in checked luggage.
